title.narrative: Sustainable Accelerated Growth in Egyp

description.narrative: The project implemented by CEOSS, an Egyptian NGO of public utility working for benefit of Egyptian communities and citizens since 1950s, in partnership with Positive Planets. It seeks to provide specialised, professional and innovative Business Development Services (BDS) to 60 Microenterprises (MEs) targeted by SAGE through one central Entrepreneurship Development Services Unit (EDSU) to be established in CEOSS and 12 branches to be established in partner CSOs in the action through sub-grants. SAGE will also target unemployed youth in the three governorates through providing vocational and administrative trainings to enhance their skills, and provide job opportunities whether in 60 supported microenterprises (MEs) or other job opportunities available in the job market. SAGE is to be implemented over a period of 36 months, including a 6 months inception phase.
